elements.name: Cycle drawing ribbon display by double-clicking its active tab

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-drawing.odd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a drawing document is active in the MCAD Software
the ribbon display control is configured to cycle through all modes
the Place Views tab shows its full command groups
the user double-clicks the active Place Views tab
the ribbon shows compact Create, Modify, Sketch and Sheets group buttons
the drawing workspace has more vertical space
the user double-clicks the active Place Views tab again
the ribbon shows the group titles in a narrow strip
the user double-clicks the active Place Views tab again
the ribbon shows tabs without the group strip
the user double-clicks the active Place Views tab again
the full Place Views command groups are visible
